hover_interaction.visibility_note: The text must remain above the animated card background at every hover value.

loading_animation.note: Rotation is per widget instance and the shader arc reads the animated rotation value.

integration_constraints: Preserve the current dimensions, spacing, IDs, widget names, and displayed copy.
Hover and time are independent animation tracks and must not write each other's values.
Do not add runtime downloads, external assets, event-handler scaffolding, or a second animation system.
